items.title: Tom Scott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: So I pulled what I used to refer to as an Oliver Nelson because Oliver was my hero, my mentor.

ctx.x: Yeah Plas of course. So it was supposed to be, I think we did it, we had four sessions, evening sessions planned to do all — was it eight tunes? Seven tunes? Eight tunes? I’m not sure. And I had written you know, they had given me their master rhythm parts which the rhythm section had used to make their tracks. And if I may get technical for a second, the tune “Deacon Blues” started out with a chord which was just a triad. It was a E minor, you could call it an E minor chord with a G in the bass. G in the bottom…
Was it a, speaking of being technical, was it a C sharp or was it a C?
